description: 配布マップの関数で多い型だけで作った扉の仕掛け（#361）。load で目的変数と storage を用意し、tick でタイマーを進め、しきい値で関数を呼んで開き、schedule で閉じる。委譲先のない advancement の行を load と tick に混ぜ、後続の行と以後の tick が続くことも確かめる

m2:door/load: data modify storage m2:door log set value []
data modify storage m2:door config set value {open:{delay:2},name:"door"}
m2:door/tick: execute if score #phase door matches 0 if score #timer door >= #limit door run function m2:door/open
execute store result storage m2:door timer int 1 run scoreboard players get #timer door
m2:door/open: data modify storage m2:door log append value {event:"open"}
execute store result storage m2:door log[-1].tick int 1 run scoreboard players get #timer door
execute store result score #delay door run data get storage m2:door config.open.delay
m2:door/close: data modify storage m2:door log append value {event:"close"}
execute store result storage m2:door log[-1].tick int 1 run scoreboard players get #timer door
data modify storage m2:door closed set from storage m2:door config
execute if data storage m2:door closed.name run scoreboard players set #named door 1
execute unless data storage m2:door closed.open run function m2:door/record
m2:door/record: data modify storage m2:door log append value {event:"record"}
m2:door/pulse: data modify storage m2:door log append value {event:"pulse"}
execute store result storage m2:door log[-1].tick int 1 run scoreboard players get #timer door
execute if score #pulses door matches ..1 run schedule function m2:door/pulse 3t
m2:door/never: data modify storage m2:door log append value {event:"never"}

knownDiffs.storage.m2:door.log: BE のランタイムは期限の来た schedule を tick 関数より前に動かすが、Java は tick 関数の後に動かす。load で予約した pulse が1回分早い tick 関数の前に動き、記録の順序と tick 番号がずれる（#440）
